subtopic.name: Low-rank adapters for LLM fine-tuning
subtopic.summary: Papers that adapt large language models by training small low-rank matrices instead of all weights, to cut memory and cost.

reading_item.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
reading_item.reason: Cited by 31 of the 48 papers here, a shared foundation.

gap.title: Low-rank adapters are rarely tested outside English
gap.statement: In the papers analysed here, low-rank adapter methods are evaluated almost only on English benchmarks; their behaviour on low-resource languages is untested.
gap.why_it_might_not_be_a_gap: Multilingual evaluations may exist in papers outside the collection or in appendices.
